description: This file defines the SynchronizeNotes class responsible for synchronizing notes between local storage and remote cloud services, supporting different synchronization methods and handling note creation, updates, and deletions.

classes.name: SynchronizeNotes
classes.description: Handles synchronization of notes between local and remote sources, supporting different sync methods and managing note actions.

classes.name: NoteAction
classes.description: Sealed interface representing actions (Create, Update, Delete) to be performed on notes during synchronization.

classes.name: SyncNotesResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the results of the synchronization process, including lists of local and remote updates and new mappings.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method to perform synchronization between local and remote notes based on the specified method (MAPPING or TITLE).

methods.name: logDebug
methods.description: Helper function for logging debug messages.
